messages:
Kiran: quick UX question — we want a "soft-landing" degrade mode that sends traffic to a cheaper/light model + sanitized fallback. Audit needs: traceability for compliance but not a firehose of logs. Proposal: A) full trace for every degraded request; B) sampled traces + full metadata + event id; C) event-only logs (id + reason) with on-demand fetch. Thoughts? @Marta

Marta: leaning B. Sampling keeps noise down but we must be able to reconstruct sessions via event id. UI idea: a 'Degraded sessions' timeline in the rollout detail with per-event link to the audit blob. I can sketch a mock.

Mike: engineering caveat — sampling rate matters for catching regressions. Too low and QA misses patterns. Storage/cost impact is real. Suggest per-customer sample_rate + default fallback. Also need a clear schema for "why_degraded" to avoid churn.

Sam: from SRE/security — for enterprise P2 we need immutable audit records. Event IDs + short-lived blob stored in object store (signed URL) seems fine. Default TTL 90d, configurable to 365d for regulated customers. Make sure deletion paths are auditable.

ops-bot: config snippet suggestion:
```json
{"degrade_mode":"soft-landing","audit":"sampled","sample_rate":0.05,"retain_days":90,"why_fields":["error_code","latency_ms","route"]}
```
Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/rollouts#soft-landing-audit

Jordan: acceptance criteria from product POV: 1) Console shows degraded-rate per rollout and sampling rate, 2) Each degraded event exposes a "why_degraded" field, 3) Operators can export degraded sessions (CSV/JSON) and click-through to blob. Also want a replay button for debugging (see below).

Leah: UI thoughts — compact pill in rollout header: "Soft-landing · 5% sampled" with tooltip that explains retention and provides quick link to export. Inline show top 3 reasons for degrade.

Kiran: question about replay — can we add an operator-level "replay to primary" that re-runs the degraded request against the primary model for comparison? Useful for debugging regressions but needs rate limiting and idempotency.

Mike: replay is doable but needs nonce and idempotent execution path. Prefer queueing replays to a low-cost batch window to avoid impacting production. Also costs — add a replay_quota per-team.

Sam: +1 on quota and add audit entry for every replay. Replays should be flagged in logs and flagged in the UI as "operator action" for compliance.

Kiran: ok — I'll draft a short spec: sampling defaults, admin override per-org, replay_quota, retention tiers, and a minimal schema for why_degraded. Will attach a Figma mock. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT? :thumbsup:

Marta: works for me.

Mike: ok for eng. I can mock the server-side flags and quota endpoints pre-sync.

Sam: fine, will add retention/delete runbook notes.

Kiran: great — thanks everyone. I'll post the draft in the doc channel when ready.
